introduction: Galav yuulj, Aghchin old man left the world with his 2 daughters Esu and Mesu. Agchin, who struggled with his life to leave his descendants in the world because of the dreams of man, ran out of ways and raped his youngest daughter and passed away to heaven herself. After sending their father to the countryside, the two girls found a man with a fatal wound and took him with joy. Oldoy did not bring them happiness, and the sister killed Oldoy, suspecting her brother, and the tragedy of the two sisters began. Based on the timeless legend, this film will be the second installment in the "On the Edge of Doom" series.
